Console.placeholder: Please share your concerns or situation...
Console.template_1_text: I received an offer from an early AI startup with a 35 million KRW raise. However, it requires 70 hours a week and frequent weekend work. I want to build seed money fast, should I move?
Console.template_2_text: Got a 3 million KRW bonus in our Shinhan account today with my wife Sujin, but I was so stressed I bought a limited edition keyboard for 98,000 KRW on Coupang.
Console.template_3_text: Leaving work at 22:00 for 3 days in a row. About to take the train at Shinjuku station but I am so exhausted I want to order 30,000 KRW of late-night delivery food.
Console.template_4_text: Finished this quarter closing and had a beef dinner with the team at Gangnam station, paid 250,000 KRW. Relieved stress but worried about next week's living expenses.
Console.template_5_text: Paid 50,000 KRW for the weekend Yangjaecheon half marathon to recover health and keep my hobby quota. Promised my wife we would run together this weekend.
